description: Schema definition for the core database of a medical prescription platform, including tables for users, roles, prescriptions, blockchain references, audit logs, and metadata, along with triggers for timestamp updates.
calls: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prescription_audit_logs
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prescription_metadata
